support_decisions.reason: Existing gloss sense decision: Locative singular form of amb ('mango / mango tree') inflected with the case ending -i.
Existing gloss sense decision: Locative adverbial form of sahaj, expressing natural spiritual equilibrium, poise, or effortless stillness.
Existing gloss sense decision: Verbal form derived from sārnā, functioning here in the sense of looking after, caring for, or sustaining.

translations.literal_english: If I become a cuckoo, I would dwell in the mango tree,

wording_decisions.reason: Candidate 'in the mango tree' captures the full locative inflection -i and arboreal sense of amb witnessed in Singh (1895).
wording_decisions.ordinary_paraphrase: dwelling inside the leafy branches of a mango tree

translations.literal_english: in natural stillness, contemplating the Word,

wording_decisions.reason: Compositional phrase 'in natural stillness' conveys the locative case and unforced spiritual poise of sahaj without foreign retention.
wording_decisions.ordinary_paraphrase: in an effortless, innate state of peaceful equilibrium

translations.literal_english: He cherishes all living beings and creatures;

wording_decisions.reason: Attested sense of sārnā in Gurbani is to look after, care for, or cherish, matching candidate cherish (WordNet synset wordnet:3.1:v:01780135).
